```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: C13-nazbd
vectorfield_plot(y ~ 1.5 - x, x ~ x - y , 
                 domain(y = 0:5, x = 0:5),
                 npts = 9,
                 stretch = 0.6) |>
  gf_theme(theme_minimal(base_size = 14)) |>
  gf_refine(coord_fixed())
```


1. `r devoirsTF(TRUE, id="flow-gsl-1-k3")` The y-component of the flow depends strongly on the value of x.

::: {.callout-tip collapse=true}
Focus, for instance, on the column of flow arrows stacked up at y = 0. For different values of x in that column, the flow arrows have different y components.
:::

2. `r devoirsTF(TRUE, id="flow-gsl-2-ws")` The x-component of the flow depends strongly on the value of y.

::: {.callout-tip collapse=true}
Focus, for instance, on the row of flow arrows where x = 0. Moving left to right along the y axis, the x-component of the flow goes from zero to strongly negative.
:::

3. `r devoirsTF(TRUE, id="flow-gsl-3-8d")` The x-component of the flow depends strongly on the value of x.

4. `r devoirsTF(FALSE, id="flow-gsl-4-is")` The y-component of the flow depends strongly on the value of y.


:::
